verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms replying to customers is possible via the MCP integration ("reply to customers" listed as an action from LLM tools), implying the underlying feedback record supports replies, but there is no direct documentation of the native in-app reply-to-customer workflow within the feedback record itself. missing for 10: direct product docs/screenshots of replying to a commenter within the Canny feedback record UI, evidence of email/notification triggered to the customer, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this closing-the-loop workflow.
